disclaimer: Network-window estimate, not a quote from a bank, and not financial, legal, or payments advice. Originating-bank cutoffs are earlier than Fed deadlines. Receiver availability is not checked.

ach.source_sentence: Future Dated Forward Items: transmission deadline 2:15 a.m. ET (0215 ET), settlement 8:30 a.m. ET (0830 ET) on the future business day. Schedule effective September 12, 2022, transcribed 2026-10-21.
ach.funds_availability_sentence: Next-day credits must be available by 9:00 a.m. RDFI local time on the settlement date. The default proxy is 9:00 a.m. Eastern. receiver_timezone moves this availability clock only.

same_day_ach.source_sentence: Same Day Eligible Forward Items: 10:30 a.m. ET settles 1:00 p.m. ET; 2:45 p.m. ET settles 5:00 p.m. ET; 4:45 p.m. ET settles 6:00 p.m. ET, all current day.
same_day_ach.amount_cap_sentence: The ACH Rules exclude from eligibility international transactions (IAT), automated enrollment entries (ENR) and transactions above $1,000,000.

windows.funds_availability_sentence: First same-day window: funds must be available by 1:30 p.m. RDFI local time. The default proxy is 1:30 p.m. Eastern. receiver_timezone moves this availability clock only.
Second same-day window: funds must be available by 5:00 p.m. RDFI local time. The default proxy is 5:00 p.m. Eastern. receiver_timezone moves this availability clock only.

Third same-day window: NACHA requires availability by the end of the RDFI processing day, which can be the next morning. The default stand-in is 11:59 p.m. Eastern on the settlement date, not a promise. receiver_timezone moves this clock only.

fedwire.source_sentence: 6:45 p.m. ET Customer Transfers. Core customer transfer. pacs.008. CTRC. The cutoff times and closing time of the Fedwire Funds Service for online messages are inclusive of the minute listed.
fedwire.open_sentence: The funds-transfer business day begins at 9:00 p.m. ET on the preceding calendar day and ends at 7:00 p.m. ET. On a Sunday preceding a Monday funds-transfer business day, the Fedwire Funds Service will open at 9:00 p.m. ET on Sunday.
fedwire.originator_open_note: Assumption, not a Fed cutoff and not a specific bank's posted hours. The network open on the preceding calendar day is earlier than a sending bank's desk.
fedwire.models: core customer transfer only (pacs.008 CTRC). Bank-to-bank pacs.009 BTRC, whose cutoff is 7:00 p.m. ET, is not modeled.

rtp.source_sentence: The RTP network operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. This quote does not check whether either institution participates. The Clearing House routing file is not redistributed.

fednow.source_sentence: The FedNow Service operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, every day of the year. This quote does not check whether either institution participates. The FedNow routing-number list prohibits commercial reuse and is not in this repo.

usdc_base.source_sentence: Static inclusion and confirmation assumptions until a live Base fee read is wired. Chain confirmation is not a bank credit.

usdc_solana.source_sentence: Static inclusion and confirmation assumptions until a live Solana fee read is wired. Chain confirmation is not a bank credit.
